title: Grammy-nominated singer Acantha Lang on using soul music as a means of connection
summary: For Acantha Lang, soul music is "honest" and "moving". The Grammy-nominated singer-songwriter told FRANCE 24 that she believes "when people really connect with soul music, there's a kind of magic that happens".
